---

Drop the `FastAndPurrious` folder into your KSA user directory's `mods/`, register it in
`manifest.toml`, and launch through StarMap. See the README for the full guide.

Works on Windows and Linux — the mod is a portable .NET assembly.

Release build: no debug symbols, log starts at INFO. Tick **Verbose log** in the
panel if you are reporting a bug.

listing.name: Fast & Purrious
listing.abstract: Drivable cars for Kitten Space Agency, with their own springs, tyres and engine.
listing.description:
Cars for Kitten Space Agency. KSA has no wheels, so these bring their own: springs, tyres, an engine and a gearbox, all simulated by the mod and driven with the keys you already fly with.

## The cars

**Beach Buggy**: a fibreglass dune buggy on long-travel coil-overs, with a Beetle engine behind the seats and two kittens up front.

**Cadillac Eldorado**: a red 1976 convertible with the top down, four seats, a whitewall on every corner and a V8 that sounds like one. It floats on its springs and leans into a turn. It also flies, on rockets hidden under its floor.

## What you get

- Real suspension and tyre grip: the car leans, squats and slides, and the gearbox shifts on its own.
- An engine you can hear, cut from recordings of the real thing.
- The driver kitten holds the steering wheel and turns it.
- Kittens can get out on EVA and climb back in through the doors.
- Headlights with dipped and main beam, and tail lights that brighten when you brake.
- An Unflip button for when you end up on your roof.
- Cars bounce instead of breaking up in a hard landing or a crash.
- Move any craft with the mouse: click to pick it up, click again to set it down.

The Eldorado adds:

- Four lift rockets under the floor: half throttle hovers, more climbs.
- Two boost rockets on the tail.
- Downward thrusters that press it onto the ground for grip, which is what makes it drivable on Luna.
- A hover hold: with the lift rockets and the downward thrusters on together it keeps its height.
- A scoop on the nose in three sizes, 3.4 m, 6 m and 10 m, for shoving rocks about, with a slider for how heavy the rocks are.

## Driving

Find **Beach Buggy** or **Cadillac Eldorado** under Vehicles in the editor, or launch one from the vehicle list, and fill the seats in the launch window.

| Control | Default key | |
| --- | --- | --- |
| pitch | W / S | throttle, and brake then reverse |
| yaw | A / D | steer |

## Flying the Eldorado

| Control | Default key | |
| --- | --- | --- |
| engine start / shutdown | Z / X | light and cut the lift rockets |
| throttle up / down | Up / Down | half hovers, more climbs |
| pitch | W / S | in the air, lean forward or back |
| yaw | A / D | in the air, bank left or right |
| roll | Q / E | in the air, turn left or right |
| sprint | Left Shift | hold to fire the boost rockets |
| toggle RCS | R | switch the downward thrusters |

The Fast & Purrious panel is on screen while you are in a car, with the headlights, the scoop size, the rock weight and Unflip.
